title: Wild Smoked American Lamb Tagine
description: A pungent and dense American dish featuring chimichurri sauce and smoked lamb, cooked in a traditional clay tajine vessel, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, garlic, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb pieces, making sure they are evenly coated.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chimichurri sauce to the tajine vessel and stir to combine.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
